dedupe_keys.name: inspire data specification on buildings technical guidelines

description: The INSPIRE data specification on Buildings sets out the technical guidelines that EU member states follow when publishing building data under the INSPIRE Directive on spatial information in Europe. The current guidelines are published in the INSPIRE Knowledge Base by the INSPIRE Maintenance and Implementation Group, dated 31 January 2024, with a link to the specification sources on GitHub. Coverage: EU member states' building data. Access: the guidelines document on the Knowledge Base. Licence: not stated on the page read; free. Caveats: the page read gives only the publication record, so the model content (for example 2D and 3D profiles and core attributes) should be checked in the document itself. Simulation uses are a shared European structure for building footprints and attributes that exposure and energy models can read across countries. Related records: CityGML and the national building datasets in this piece.
